items.title: Paul Barbarin Interview, 1957-03-27
items.q: And I have a brother that's now playing with the, with our Papa Selle's Dance Band, on the direction of Edith Pearson. His name is Lewis Barberang.

ctx.x: Your father's name is? Is it John Barberang. How many brothers do you have?

I have a brother we just lost about a year or so ago. His name is Lucien Barberang. He died. And I have a brother that's now playing with the, with our Papa Selle's Dance Band, on the direction of Edith Pearson. His name is Lewis Barberang. Then I have another brother that plays a pretty good trumpet. But I don't know, he, he just rather work in there, before working in the daytime, and fooling with the trumpet, I guess, I don't know. I don't understand him. His name is Willie Barberang. He doesn't play very…

items.title: Louis Barbarin Interview, 1960-06-22
items.q: Well, he did. Give me ideas. Paul, give me ideas.

ctx.x: Well, did he play with anybody else, you say, besides... Did he? Well, I know. Did he start on your drum?

Well, I learned him some drums. Yeah, I did. Can you tell us any more about when you started? Did your brother help you, Paul? Had he been playing long before that that you can remember? Well, Paul was playing long before I started. I knew he was older, of course. Yeah, he was playing long. Playing around with different bands around the office. Did he help you any? Did he show you how to hold the sticks or anything? Well, he did. Give me ideas. Paul, give me ideas. Did your father ever teach you anything about…
I've taken my drum lesson from Cottrell. Lewis Cottrell.
